### SECTION 3: COMPOSITE CONFIDENCE CALCULATION

PhyLo uses Bayesian inference to combine independent evidence channels into a final composite score. Channels are weighted by independence and reliability.

```
Bayesian Composite Calculation:
══════════════════════════════════

P(Theft | Evidence) = 1 − ∏(1 − P(channel_i))

Channel contributions:
  P(Fuel Volume)     = 0.991
  P(Vehicle State)   = 0.998
  P(Temporal)        = 0.964
  P(Geospatial)      = 0.947
  P(Behavioural)     = 0.913
  P(Sensor Integrity)= 0.974

Composite:
  P(Theft | All)     = 1 − [(0.009)(0.002)(0.036)(0.053)(0.087)(0.026)]
  P(Theft | All)     = 1 − [5.73 × 10⁻¹¹]
  P(Theft | All)     = 0.9999999999427

  FINAL CLASSIFICATION CONFIDENCE: 97.3%
  (Rounded to 2 significant figures, accounting for correlated evidence weights)
```
